title: Nordic Roasted Norwegian Turkey Neck Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Norwegian dish featuring roasted turkey neck, cooked to perfection in a tagine pot, with a crunchy exterior and tender interior, perfect for a low-sodium diet. This meal prep recipe is easy to make and serves as a delicious dinner option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, salt-free seasoning blend, and black pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the turkey neck, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the turkey neck in a tagine pot and arrange the chopped carrots, potatoes, and onions around it.
Roast the turkey neck in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and continue roasting for an additional 60 minutes, or until the turkey neck is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Baste the turkey neck with the pan juices every 20 minutes to keep it moist.
Remove the tagine pot from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
